nodes.label: AppModel
nodes.rationale: GitHub login is mandatory and gates all session connections; profile broadcasting is debounced so per-keystroke edits do not fan out kilobytes to every group member; the GitHub device-flow task is generation-guarded so a cancelled or dying task cannot overwrite state set by a newer flow.

nodes.label: MenuView
nodes.rationale: Popover UI excludes itself from screen capture because it shows circle codes, outgoing drafts and the GitHub device code; create and join are the same operation because knowing the code is knowing the group.

nodes.label: Windows integration workflow
nodes.rationale: Long-running integration branch platform/windows with feature sub-branches and PR-based merging; main reached only via manually reviewed PR at the end.

nodes.label: main protection rule
nodes.rationale: Never commit, push, rebase, or fast-forward main from the Windows integration; main is reached exactly once via manually reviewed PR from platform/windows.

nodes.label: notch-first interaction
nodes.rationale: Incoming messages appear in the notch, can be expanded, copied, and answered inline without opening a chat window; the notch presentation is the product.

nodes.label: capture-proof surfaces
nodes.rationale: Windows showing message content or circle codes are excluded from screen capture (NSWindow.sharingType=.none) so they are invisible in Teams/Zoom shares and screenshots; no .help() tooltips in notch content because tooltips get their own capturable window.

nodes.label: ephemeral local messaging
nodes.rationale: Munkel is designed for ephemeral local messaging with a relay that stores no message history.

nodes.label: notarization
nodes.rationale: Homebrew quarantines cask downloads and macOS Tahoe shows unsigned quarantined apps a dead-end damaged dialog; distribution without Developer ID + notarization is effectively broken for end users.

nodes.label: send-only CLI
nodes.rationale: The CLI is send-only by design: it cannot read, receive, or wait for messages.

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM end-to-end encryption
nodes.rationale: AES-256-GCM chosen over ChaChaPoly for WebCrypto/CryptoKit cross-platform interop.

nodes.label: HKDF group ID and message key derivation
nodes.rationale: Group ID and message key are derived from the human-readable group code via HKDF-SHA256 so the server only sees opaque IDs and cannot recover the code.
nodes.norm_label: hkdf group id and message key derivation

nodes.label: Ephemeral relay design
nodes.rationale: Relay stores nothing and buffers no messages; offline members simply never receive a message and presence derives from live connections.

nodes.label: Capture invariant for NotchHostingContent
nodes.rationale: Content must be embedded directly without lazy conditional branches so CaptureExclusion mounts in the same SwiftUI update pass before any content-bearing frame is composited.

nodes.label: Window-level capture exclusion
nodes.rationale: sharingType=.none is set before the panel is ordered front and re-asserted on every re-host path so no capturable panel can reach the screen.

nodes.label: NotchPanel
nodes.rationale: Drop-in replacement for DynamicNotchKit so the app owns the notch panel coupling in one file and avoids the library's capturable rebuild race.

nodes.label: NotchPanelWindow
nodes.rationale: Long-lived NSPanel that applies capture exclusion via sharingType=.none once per session, eliminating the post-expand re-assert race.

nodes.label: NotchScreenMetrics
nodes.rationale: Single-source geometry measurement that subsumes hardwareNotchSize and fixes the library's hardcoded NSScreen.screens[0].

nodes.label: NotchHostingContent
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI root that embeds caller Content directly so app-level CaptureExclusion mounts in the same pass without a lazy branch.

nodes.label: Two-layer capture exclusion
nodes.rationale: App layer frame-exact exclusion plus component layer source-of-truth exclusion, ensuring the notch is never capturable.

nodes.label: DynamicNotchKit replacement
nodes.rationale: Replace DynamicNotchKit because it never sets sharingType, hardcodes screens[0], and trivial hover logic can be owned in-house.

nodes.label: LAUNCH_PLATFORMS
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth for where Munkel launches and which launch badges are collected; mirrors the landing-page badge track.
